I worked out each order's value as quantity × unit price × (1 − discount%). Net revenue only includes orders with status "Completed". Q1 is January to March and Q2 is April to June.

## q1. Net revenue in March 2026
March had 22 completed orders. Two March orders are excluded as refunded (SO-2051 and SO-2054) and one as cancelled (SO-2059).

Adding the completed orders in sequence: 361 + 129.20 + 1,296 + 144.40 + 433.20 + 34.20 + 380 + 370.50 + 190 + 95 + 38 + 304 + 61.75 + 950 + 378 + 95 + 55.25 + 739.50 + 580 + 95 + 325 + 1,305 = **£8,360.00**
